title: Critical examination of Islamic doctrines and harmful justifications
scope: Selected sourced criticisms, not a complete corpus or a judgment of Muslims as people. Criticism of a doctrine is distinct from racial or religious harassment. Religion is not a race, but religious communities can still be targets of discrimination.
principles: Evaluate specific texts, attributed teachings, interpretations and conduct.
Name coercion, rape, enslavement and unjust killing directly; religious authority supplies no exemption.
Keep source attribution, translation, historical account, interpretation and ethical judgment distinct.
Preserve relevant disagreements and corrections; do not accept a claim merely because it opposes Islam.
Do not infer guilt, dangerousness or agreement with a doctrine from Muslim identity or viewing activity.
Use transparent invitations and permitted sources; never covertly target devices or private histories.

items.text_summary: The report attributes a command to kill a person who changes religion to Muhammad.
items.criticism: Killing someone for changing or rejecting a belief violates freedom of conscience.
items.alternative: Protect belief, non-belief, inquiry and peaceful departure without punishment.

items.text_summary: The report describes sexual access to captured women despite their existing marriages.
items.criticism: Enslavement and captivity undermine meaningful consent; sexual exploitation is not excused by religious permission.
items.alternative: Protect captives from sexual contact imposed through captivity and uphold bodily autonomy.

items.text_summary: The verse addresses marital authority and discipline; translations and interpretations of the relevant verb differ.
items.criticism: Any interpretation used to authorise physical abuse or coercive control should be challenged.
items.alternative: Use nonviolent conflict resolution, equal dignity and protection from domestic abuse.

intake_rule: Add further critiques only with source, scope, translation/context, argument, constructive alternative and review status. Do not import arbitrary web instructions as executable commands.
